subject: ACME MSA + Order Form: signer roster dry-run & escrow steps
body:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>; ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: mark.rosen@acme.com, samantha.li@acme.com
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME MSA — redlines + signer Qs

Hi Lauren / Ben,

Attached are ACME legal's redlines to the MSA (PDF) and the revised Order Form (Word). A few items we need to lock before DocuSign:

- Signatory authority: Samantha Li is the authorised sig for Order Forms at our side, but legal wants a pre-affirmation email from Redwood confirming who will countersign for Redwood and the controller contact for audit.
- Execution order: ACME needs the MSA executed first, then the Order Form. Will Redwood be able to route as sequential envelopes?
- Witness / notarization: Not required by ACME but counsel flagged a potential government customer asking for notarized proof later — we want a clean chain of custody.
- Attachments: please confirm final clean copy PDF and who retains the archival copy.

Files attached: ACME_MSA_redlines_20280510.pdf; OrderForm_ACME_v2.docx

Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the signer and whether you can do a dry-run/preview of the DocuSign routing before we hit sign day?

Thanks,

Olivia Park
Senior Counsel, Acme Corp
olivia.park@acme.com

-----
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MSA — redlines + signer Qs

Hi Olivia — thanks for the materials. Looping in Ben (sales ops / execution) and Jordan (legal ops) to run a short dry-run and confirm the signatory roster.

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood sig: I will countersign the MSA on behalf of Redwood (VP, Partnerships) unless legal needs exec-level signoff — Ben and Jordan, flag if that's an issue.
- Sequential envelopes: yes — we can do MSA first, then Order Form as a follow-up envelope. We typically do sequential routing in DocuSign to preserve order.
- Clean copies & custody: we will produce MSA_CleanCopy_v4.pdf as the final artifact and store the archival copy in the deal folder; we will also share the signed PDF to ACME's counsel and the designated contacts.

Ben / Jordan: can you do a practice envelope this morning (no signatures) that mirrors ACME's requested routing (MSA -> Redwood sig -> ACME sig Samantha Li) and confirm the envelope settings (email auth, reminder cadence, audit trail retention)? Also confirm whether we should include an optional witness field for the government-customer contingency (it would be a non-mandatory signer).

Proposed timeline: dry-run today > final clean copy generated by Mon 5/15 > signature window Thurs 5/18. Let me know if that works for ACME.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

-----
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>; jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme.com>; Mark Rosen <mark.rosen@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MSA — redlines + signer Qs

Thanks Lauren / Olivia — I can take the dry-run. Action plan: 

1) I will create a test envelope in DocuSign this morning with the following route:
   - Envelope 1 (sequential):
     * Role A: Redwood Countersign (lauren_bishop) — embedded signing allowed
     * Role B: ACME Signatory (Samantha Li) — remote signing
   - Envelope settings: email authentication for ACME, 7-day expiry, 2 reminders (3d, 6d), include a non-mandatory witness role after signature fields (visible but optional).

2) I'll attach a PDF mock-up (no signatures) and send a preview link to the internal roster for verification.

3) Once Lauren signs MSA in production, DocuSign will auto-create Envelope 2 for the Order Form (attached as a follow-up document).

Attachments I'll upload to the test: execution_grid_proposal.xlsx (routing matrix), MSA_CleanCopy_v4.pdf (placeholder).

Notes: Jordan — please confirm whether the legal ops gate requires us to capture signer IP and verify ID (we currently capture audit trail; ACME counsel may want an extra ID step). I can add ID check with DocuSign ID Verify if needed (additional cost).

I will post the preview link here when ready.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment stubs: execution_grid_proposal.xlsx (xlsx), MSA_CleanCopy_v4.pdf (pdf)

-----
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MSA — redlines + signer Qs

Ben / Lauren — quick legal-ops confirmation:
- IP / audit trail is captured by default; add DocuSign ID Verify only if ACME requests it in writing.
- We will stamp the final clean copy (MSA_CleanCopy_v4.pdf) with execution metadata (timestamp, envelope ID, signer emails) and push to the Redwood archival bucket for the DEAL-4521 folder.
- For escrow: if ACME wants a third-party escrow, we need to add a short escrow agreement as an exhibit and confirm the escrow agent details prior to signature.

If the above is acceptable I approve the dry-run. I will also prepare a one-page execution checklist (who signs, envelope order, attachments, reminders) and drop it in the deal folder.

-Jordan Blake
Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@acme.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>; ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MSA — redlines + signer Qs

Appreciate the fast turnaround. The plan and timeline look good from ACME's side (dry-run this morning is perfect). Two small asks before the dry-run preview: 

1) Please mark the Redwoods sig block to show title (VP, Partnerships) so our records clearly show signing authority.
2) Can you add a single DocuSign custom field with our PO number (we'll provide it before the Order Form envelope)?

Once I have the preview link I'll run it by Mark Rosen and Samantha Li and confirm the signing window for Thurs 5/18.

Thanks again — looking forward to the dry-run link.

Olivia
Senior Counsel, Acme Corp

[Attachments referenced above: ACME_MSA_redlines_20280510.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_ACME_v2.docx (docx), execution_grid_proposal.xlsx (xlsx), MSA_CleanCopy_v4.pdf (pdf)]

DocuSign preview (test envelope): https://www.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123DEF
